experiment: R1 (D-253): the garment generated apart from the body
status: AUTHORISED by D-255 (D-255 R1: 3 CALLS AUTHORISED): each entry is ONE single-use call; no earlier permission is reused; the plan r1-plan-v1.json stays the unauthorised plan it was

meta.why: authorisation is the exact token in D-255's decision status plus this file's unspent entries, never a general boolean
meta.kind: a bounded method experiment: no catalogue, no runtime, no activation, no item approval

budget.separateFrom: every earlier budget (D-207, D-218, D-228, D-235, D-246 b1): all closed and not reused
budget.enforcedLimit: the call count (three one-shot claims); the price is an estimate

price.source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing (Standard, gpt-image-2.5-sunburst: text input $5.00, image input $8.00, image output $30.00 per 1M tokens) — the same as the documented basis of 2026-10-28
price.note: an estimate, not a guaranteed maximum: the token counts are measured on another request shape; the billed amount is read on the OpenAI usage page

privacy.cSentToApi: allowed for these three calls only (owner, 2026-10-29)
privacy.canvasesSentToApi: allowed for these three calls only (the cuts' private template canvases, derived from generated items on C)
privacy.publishOrTrack: never — C, the canvases, the raw results and every review sheet stay outside both clones (D-127 §2)

frozen.evaluation: tools/avatar/northstar-r1-evaluate.mjs (the automatic measures, the review sheets and the record the adapter requires before the next call)
frozen.noChangeDuringTheExperiment: the method, its limits, the checks and their thresholds are not changed while the experiment runs; any later correction is a new method version

request.canvasGenerator: node tools/avatar/northstar-r1-proof.mjs --out <dir outside the repo> (deterministic; identical bytes in four runs)

acceptance.automatic: the plan's measures: registration within ±16 px and not at the window edge, template core holes ≤ 0.5 %, paint outside ≤ 25 % of the core, fitCheck (d232 fit revision) passed, every partner outfit with the template item's result
beyondAlpha: the whole cut is covered with usable material: core holes, partial-alpha core pixels and core opaque share are measured; a hole is never filled and never counted as passed
neckband, cuffs, pocket, waistband and collar fit the cut visually
no second outline inside the cut's contour, no doubled fold shading, no clipped detail where the material meets the cut's contour and shading (the second-outline ink inside the edge is measured)
the pattern is kept across body and sleeves
no skin or background is drawn into the material
acceptance.review: the assistant reviews every item and its critical seams visually (the evaluation's sheets); review is not manual effort

classes.automaticallyUsable: every automatic measure passed AND the visual review finds none of the defects above
classes.technicallyRejected: placement, holes, fit or format failed

acceptance.combo2Pattern: the known COMBO-2 sensitivity to a high-contrast pattern below a hem (D-253) is reported apart as its own finding; the check is not changed

stopRules: credit or access: HTTP 401, 403 or 429, or an error code naming quota or billing
uncertain dispatch: DISPATCHED_RESULT_UNKNOWN, NOT_DISPATCHED, RESPONSE_BODY_UNREADABLE, UNEXPECTED, or a claim without a written outcome
request shape: HTTP 400 that is not a moderation block, or any HTTP 5xx
moderation: a moderation block (that call is spent)
template ignored: an R1 record whose coverage of the template core is below 0.80
processing: a received picture without its R1 record (northstar-r1-evaluate.mjs) stops the next call until it is evaluated
